# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book illustrates every option of `did_multiplegt_stat` — the heterogeneity-robust
difference-in-differences estimator for continuously-distributed treatments with stayers —
side by side in **Stata** and **Python**.

> **Paper:** de Chaisemartin, C., D'Haultfœuille, X., Pasquier, F., Sow, D., Vazquez-Bare, G. (2024).
> *Difference-in-Differences for Continuous Treatments and Instruments with Stayers.*

---

## Installation

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Stata

```stata
ssc install did_multiplegt_stat, replace
```

### Python

```bash
pip install did-multiplegt-stat
```

:::

---

## Datasets

| Dataset | Variables | Source |
|---------|-----------|--------|
| `gazoline_did_multiplegt_stat.dta` | `lngca` (log gasoline consumption), `tau` (tax rate) | Li et al. (2014) |
| `wagepan.dta` | `lwage` (log wage), `union` (union status) | Vella & Verbeek (1998) |
| `gentzkowetal_didtextbook.dta` | `prestout` (voter turnout), `numdailies` (newspapers) | Gentzkow et al. (2011) |

```python
import pandas as pd
gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)
gentzkow = pd.read_stata(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anzonyquispe/did_book/main/did_applied_book/data/gentzkowetal_didtextbook.dta"
)
```

---

## Structure

| Chapter | Content |
|---------|---------|
| **1. All Options** | I.01–I.30: polynomial order, IV-WAS, weights, controls, switchers, cluster, TWFE, cross-validation, trimming |
| **2. By Group** | III.01–III.04: by_fd, by_baseline |
| **3. Wagepan** | IV.01–IV.04: exact_match, discrete treatment, IV-WAS, other_treatments |
| **4. Applied Examples** | V.01–VI.02: Li et al. (2014) and Gentzkow et al. (2011) |
| **5. ML Estimators** | ML.01–ML.08: Random Forest, Neural Network, Bagging |
